hub.headline: Catacomb 3-D was a 1991 first-person game whose ray-casting renderer led to Wolfenstein 3D.
hub.next: Build the DOS source as released and record a reproducible build and a playable test under an emulator.
hub.what_it_was: One of the first texture-mapped first-person games on the PC. Its ray caster draws walls column by column from a 2D grid, the technique Wolfenstein 3D refined a year later.
hub.what_survives: The source was published on 5 June 2014 under GPL-2.0 by the CatacombGames organisation. Game data is not covered by that licence.

name: Catacomb 3-D
summary: The 1991 Softdisk and id Software ray-caster, released as source under GPL-2.0 in 2014.
